System Requirements Function Description

1. Front-end Function
Film and TV Information Browsing: Users can browse the latest movie and TV series information
Film and TV Reviews: Users can comment on movies and TV series
Film and TV Sharing: Users can share their favorite movies and TV series
Film and TV Rankings: Users can view the most popular movie and TV series rankings
Film and TV Search: Users can search for movies and TV series of interest by keywords
Crew Information Query: Users can query the crew information of movies and TV series, such as directors, actors, etc.
User Login: Users can register and log in to the website to enjoy more personalized services
Crew Login: Crew members can register and log in to the website to publish and manage relevant information
User Registration: Users can register to become website members
Crew Registration: Crew members can register to become website members

2. Backstage functions
General user management: Administrators can manage the account information of registered users, such as adding, deleting, and modifying user information
Crew information management: Administrators can manage the account information of registered crews, such as adding, deleting, and modifying crew information
Administrator information management: Administrators can manage their own account information, such as changing passwords, viewing logs, etc.
News information management: Administrators can publish, edit, and delete news information
News column management: Administrators can add, delete, and modify news columns
Film and television information publishing management: Administrators can publish, edit, and delete information about movies and TV series
Comment information management: Administrators can view, review, and delete user comment information
Film and television ranking management: Administrators can adjust the ranking rules for movies and TV series
System maintenance: Administrators can perform basic system maintenance, such as backing up the database, updating the system, etc.

-- Schema for database: rschema_0246
CREATE TABLE `admin_user` (
  `admin_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `real_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_login_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`admin_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_admin_user_username` (`username`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `general_user` (
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `nickname` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `gender` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `avatar_url` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_general_user_username` (`username`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `crew_member` (
  `crew_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `real_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `role_type` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `bio` text,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`crew_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_crew_member_username` (`username`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `news_column` (
  `column_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `column_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `sort_order` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`column_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_news_column_name` (`column_name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `news_info` (
  `news_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `column_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `admin_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `cover_image` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `publish_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published',
  PRIMARY KEY (`news_id`),
  KEY `idx_news_info_column_id` (`column_id`),
  KEY `idx_news_info_admin_id` (`admin_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `news_info_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`column_id`) REFERENCES `news_column` (`column_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `news_info_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`admin_id`) REFERENCES `admin_user` (`admin_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `film_tv_info` (
  `media_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `media_type` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `genre` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `country_region` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `language` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `release_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `duration_minutes` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `director` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cast_list` text,
  `synopsis` text,
  `poster_url` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `trailer_url` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `publish_status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published',
  `created_by_admin_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`media_id`),
  KEY `idx_film_tv_info_created_by_admin_id` (`created_by_admin_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `film_tv_info_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by_admin_id`) REFERENCES `admin_user` (`admin_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `media_comment` (
  `comment_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `media_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `comment_content` text NOT NULL,
  `rating` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`comment_id`),
  KEY `idx_media_comment_media_id` (`media_id`),
  KEY `idx_media_comment_user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `media_comment_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`media_id`) REFERENCES `film_tv_info` (`media_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `media_comment_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `general_user` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `media_share` (
  `share_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `media_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `share_platform` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `share_url` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `shared_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`share_id`),
  KEY `idx_media_share_media_id` (`media_id`),
  KEY `idx_media_share_user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `media_share_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`media_id`) REFERENCES `film_tv_info` (`media_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `media_share_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `general_user` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `media_rank_rule` (
  `rule_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `rule_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `rule_description` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `weight_score` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_by_admin_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`rule_id`),
  KEY `idx_media_rank_rule_created_by_admin_id` (`created_by_admin_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `media_rank_rule_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by_admin_id`) REFERENCES `admin_user` (`admin_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `system_log` (
  `log_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `admin_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `action_type` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `action_detail` text,
  `ip_address` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`log_id`),
  KEY `idx_system_log_admin_id` (`admin_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `system_log_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`admin_id`) REFERENCES `admin_user` (`admin_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
